									<h2>A cosy and atmospheric setting for your camping holiday by the North Sea  </h2>
<p>Are you considering where to spend your next Danish <a href="https://thorsmindecamping.dk/en/camping/">camping holiday</a> and want a place with both comfort and nature? Then Thorsminde Camping is the right place. </p>
<p>At our campsite near Ringk&oslash;bing, we create a cosy setting for those who want a camping holiday close to both nature and water. Our location by the North Sea gives you direct access to wide-open spaces, morning sun over the fjord, and peaceful surroundings where you can enjoy <a href="https://thorsmindecamping.dk/familiecamping/">family camping</a>, an active holiday, and relaxation. </p>
<p>You&rsquo;re welcome here whether you bring a caravan, a motorhome, or want a tent pitch with plenty of space and close to nature &ndash; and of course your dog is welcome to join you on holiday too. We have many happy campers from Thybor&oslash;n, Holstebro, Ringk&oslash;bing and the surrounding area &ndash; and we look forward to welcoming you as well. <a class="custom7" title="Book holiday" href="https://v3.onlinebooking.dk/v3thorsmin" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Book your pitch</a> today. </p>								</div>

									<h2>Campsite with great facilities and different pitch types</h2>
<p>When you visit our campsite in Jutland, you can choose between two different types of pitches. At the top of the site you&rsquo;ll find screened areas with wooden fencing and grass, where you can enjoy a more private stay.&#8203; </p>
<p>As you move further down towards the fjord, you&rsquo;ll reach the meadow area, where you can stay with the most beautiful view of the water and wake up to the first rays of the morning sun.&#8203;</p>
<p>All pitches have access to electricity, and there are tables around the site that you&rsquo;re welcome to use freely &ndash; especially handy if you&rsquo;re travelling with a tent and want a flexible place to eat. In season, you can also buy freshly baked breakfast bread at reception, and our motorhome area is open all year round. </p>								</div>

						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1730" class="e-n-accordion-item">
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="1" tabindex="0" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1730">
					<span class="e-n-accordion-item-title-header"><div class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> What should we do on arrival? </div></span>

		</span>

						</summary>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-4c36f9a7 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="4c36f9a7" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>We keep reception open every day from 8&ndash;11, and afternoon arrival times are posted on the door. Outside opening hours, you can still arrive and find a pitch, giving you maximum flexibility. </p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>

						<details id="e-n-accordion-item-1731" class="e-n-accordion-item">
				<summary class="e-n-accordion-item-title" data-accordion-index="2" tabindex="-1" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e-n-accordion-item-1731">
					<span class="e-n-accordion-item-title-header"><div class="e-n-accordion-item-title-text"> What should you bring camping? </div></span>
							<span class="e-n-accordion-item-title-icon">
			<span class="e-opened"><i aria-hidden="true" class="far fa-chevron-up"></i></span>
			<span class="e-closed"><i aria-hidden="true" class="far fa-chevron-down"></i></span>
		</span>

						</summary>
				<div role="region" aria-labelledby="e-n-accordion-item-1731" class="elementor-element elementor-element-786d168 e-con-full no-padding e-flex e-con e-child" data-id="786d168" data-element_type="container">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2970b5d elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="2970b5d" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>It is recommended that you bring</p>
<p>&ndash; Light source<br>&ndash; Kitchenware<br>&ndash; Practical clothing and footwear for the West Jutland weather<br>&ndash; Power cable with a camping plug<br><br>Equipment for the activities you want to do, such as hiking, fishing or water sports.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				</div>

		</span>

				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-09c87ea elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="09c87ea" data-element_type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>The price depends on the season, pitch type and number of people. You can find current prices in our price list or under &ldquo;book now&rdquo;, where you can choose the solution that suits your holiday.&#8203;  </p>								</div>
